gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Noto Sans Cypriot reads friendly and clean, its e opening up instead of closing its eye, so lines feel easy to follow. Oswald supplies the confident, tightly knit punch up top.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-rohing: Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya feels modern and approachable, with a visibly gaping c that stays obvious at any size. Oswald adds strong, tightly knit rows of text on top.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Oswald is confident and strong, with tightly knit rows of text. Noto Sans Hatran, a neutral and approachable sans-serif with a funnel-wide e, keeps whole paragraphs gliding along smoothly.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Modern and smooth, Noto Sans Linear B carries an unobstructed path around each bend, beneath the confident Oswald. Paragraphs in this plain sans should flow along without any snagging.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-mongolian: Modern in feel, Noto Sans Mongolian lets its terminals flare outward while Oswald leads with confident, strong lettering. Give the sans-serif body a little extra size so those flares show.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-lue: Oswald speaks up with confident, tightly knit rows of text. What stands out most is Noto Sans New Tai Lue, whose modern, round, cupped letters soften all of Oswald's confident strength.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-nko: Tight, loud, confident headings over open text. Oswald packs its rows tightly while Noto Sans NKo, modern and contemporary with see-through c openings, lets long paragraphs breathe quite easily.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-old-south-ara: Oswald is confident and strong, with tightly knit rows of text. Noto Sans Old South Arabian is approachable and clean, its curved strokes ending before turning inward, and a shrunken Oswald would cede the spotlight.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans draws smooth tubular strokes, like bent copper pipe, with big open lowercase eyes. Press Start 2P adds its retro, cut-out letters pinned far apart, which is where the fun lives.
gen-righteous-gf-vend-sans: Bowls that fill the line mark Righteous, as if thin steel rod had been bent into every letter. Vend Sans draws a ruler-drawn constant-width line, so enlarging it would crowd Righteous.
